en.content: Experimentally reducing a functional group cannot be done by which one of the following reagents?

options.content: Pt-C/H<sub>2</sub>
Na/H<sub>2</sub>
Pd-C/H<sub>2</sub>
Zn/H<sub>2</sub>O

en.explanation:
Na in presence of H2, will not release electron which are required for reduction.

H2 gas also not get adsorbed on Na. Hence Na/H2 cannot be used as a reducing agent.
